name: Move my Tuesday
opening: Move my Tuesday. Rebook the 10:00 train to Hallam for Wednesday, cancel the gym before it renews, and report the streetlight outside that is still out.

script.say: Three things, then. The train first. Example Rail has a 10:00 Wednesday departure to Hallam at $120, refundable. Second Rail has 11:40 at $98, but it is not refundable, and you asked for refundable last time. I will book the 10:00 unless you want me to narrow it.

proposal.description: Reserve a refundable ticket on the 10:00 Wednesday departure to Hallam.

choice.basis: You prefer the 10:00 departure and a refundable ticket over the lowest price.

script.say: Next, the gym. Example Fitness renews on Thursday. I will cancel at the end of the paid period so you keep access until then. Pausing would keep the account but not stop the charge.

proposal.description: Cancel renewal at the end of the current billing period.

choice.selected: Cancel at the end of the billing period
considered: Cancel at the end of the billing period
choice.basis: You asked to avoid the next charge while keeping what you already paid for.
choice.commercial_influence: Retention offers are left out of this comparison

script.say: Last, the streetlight. You have not given me permission to file with Example City 311, so this one needs a grant before I can send it. I checked the open reports and found none for 700 Cedar Street.

proposal.description: Report a streetlight out at 700 Cedar Street.

choice.basis: No matching open report exists in the city's listing.

script.say: That is everything you asked for. Example Rail has acknowledged the booking and has not confirmed it, so the seat is not yours yet.
